title: Replacement of Data Command Center UPS System

onscreen_lines.desc: Bidder shall provide a single, all-inclusive lump sum price for all labor, equipment, and materials to remove and replace the Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) System in Central Hall's Data Command Center (DCC) at the Las Vegas Convention Center (LVCC), 3150 Paradise Road, Las Vegas, NV, 89109 (collectively "Project"), as specified in this ITB. This price shall include all labor, equipment, materials, supervision, staging, safety measures, and associated services required to fulfill the full scope of work as detailed in this ITB. Failure to submit a total price in this section may result in the bid being disqualified.
